anchors.title: Independent anchors
anchors.localNotice: The demo stores Ed25519 receipts in a separate witness store. Export bundles and keep the key fingerprint independently. Time comes from the local machine; no TSA or blockchain is connected.
anchors.invalidBundle: Choose a valid JSON file up to 1 MB.
anchors.MATCH: Receipt, signature and audit anchor match.
anchors.MISMATCH: Anchor mismatch. Check the bundle source and history.
anchors.snapshotSame: Current data matches the anchored snapshot.
anchors.snapshotChanged: Current data differs from the older snapshot. Reconcile activity since the anchor; legitimate updates can cause differences.

extraction.title: Extract and review terms
extraction.notice: The local extractor suggests values backed by source lines. Review the document, correct unclear fields and confirm before locking terms.
extraction.noDocument: This demo record has a filename but no original bytes. Review the values manually.
extraction.noText: Readable text is unavailable. Scanned or encrypted documents need OCR or other processing; review the original and confirm values.

rules.name: Version name
rules.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the change and its business basis.
rules.author: Author
rules.notice: Versions must preserve all 405 baseline outcomes, match 20 public samples and pass invariants before another administrator publishes. This does not verify hidden ground truth.
rules.search: Search name, rationale or version hash
rules.publishConfirm: Publish this validated configuration. It is assigned to newly saved unpinned drafts; previously pinned contracts are unchanged.
rules.tampered: Configuration hash mismatch. Do not use this version.
rules.editorNotice: Percentages must total 100% per workflow. Specification scopes, priorities, decisions and reason codes stay fixed. Expressions are checked before review.
rules.percentTotal: A workflow’s payment percentages do not total 100%.
rules.percentHint: Enter 0–100 with up to 2 decimal places.
rules.expressionRequired: Enter an expression up to 2,000 characters.
rules.previewSummary: {{evaluated}} milestones evaluated · {{matched}}/{{samples}} samples matched · {{changed}} changed · {{violations}} invariant violations
rules.previewScope: Changed milestone templates: {{templates}} (future contracts only). Submission requires zero changed outcomes across the full pack.
rules.demoReason: Demo input: preview impact before requesting review; no business outcome change is proposed.

language.order: Apply the first matching rule, in priority order 10 → 80
language.orderDetail: Stop at the first matching rule in the selected scope. Calculate penalty first, then payable amount. ELSE holds the milestone for review when no earlier rule matches.
language.catalogError: The engine variable catalog is unavailable. You can read the configuration; retry to insert variables and see units.
language.valid: Syntax and basic types valid · {{count}} expressions
language.syntaxOnly: This is static validation, not proof of correct business results. Preview all 405 milestones before submitting.
language.unchecked: The displayed content has not been syntax checked. Editing requires a new check; previous results are not reused.
language.lockedMetadata: Scope, priority, decision and reason code are fixed by the Data Pack. The description is reference text; it is not regenerated when expressions change.
language.modified: Expressions differ from the saved version. Review their business meaning and preview the impact before submitting.
language.vocabularyHint: This is a restricted DSL, not free-form JavaScript, Excel or Python. The engine reads/calculates Data Pack inputs; this screen does not decide payments.
language.syntaxHint: AND joins boolean conditions and requires spaces on both sides. Use a decimal point (0.10) and uppercase TRUE/FALSE. MIN/MAX take 1–8 numeric arguments. ELSE stands alone at priority 80. OR, NOT, IF, attributes, strings and other function calls are unsupported.
language.dateHint: Compare dates, or add calendar days, e.g. due_date + grace_period_days. Use the computed days_late_after_grace instead of subtracting dates. A missing completion date makes comparisons FALSE.
language.exampleInputs: Assume a planned 1000.00 million VND, 3 days late after grace, a 0.10% daily rate and an 8% cap. This example applies only if the penalty rule is the first match.
language.exampleResult: Penalty is 3.00 million VND; payable is 997.00 million VND. The engine rounds to 2 decimals with ROUND_HALF_UP. An open dispute still causes HOLD at priority 10; this example cannot authorize payment.
language.previewFirst: Preview the current changes and resolve blocked outcomes before submitting.

hints.condition_expression: Must return TRUE or FALSE. Priority 80 uses ELSE. Lower priority numbers run first.
hints.penalty_amount_formula: Returns a numeric million-VND value. MIN enforces the cap; penalty_amount_vnd_mn is not yet available here.
hints.payable_amount_formula: Returns a numeric million-VND value. May use penalty_amount_vnd_mn already calculated and rounded in step 1; MAX(0, …) prevents a negative result.

errors.UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: Unknown variable “{{token}}”. Choose a name from the catalog.
errors.VARIABLE_UNAVAILABLE: “{{token}}” is available only after penalty calculation, in the payable formula.
errors.EXPRESSION_REQUIRED: Enter a non-empty expression of at most 2,000 characters.
errors.SYNTAX_ERROR: Invalid syntax. Check parentheses, operators, decimal points and spaces around AND.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_EXPRESSION: This construct/operator is unsupported. See the allowed syntax.
errors.INVALID_CONSTANT: Use a finite number of at most 16 characters or TRUE/FALSE; strings and Python-style True/False are unsupported.
errors.INVALID_COMPARISON: Use one operator per comparison and join comparisons with AND.
errors.INVALID_FUNCTION: Only MIN/MAX with 1–8 positional arguments are allowed.
errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: Type mismatch: compare the same type; arithmetic needs numbers, except adding days to a date.
errors.BOOLEAN_REQUIRED: Conditions and AND operands must return TRUE/FALSE, not money or dates.
errors.NUMBER_REQUIRED: Money formulas and MIN/MAX arguments must be numeric, not conditions or dates.
errors.DIVISION_BY_ZERO: Division by zero is not allowed.
errors.FALLBACK_ORDER: ELSE is allowed only at the final rule, priority 80.
errors.EXPRESSION_TOO_COMPLEX: Expression is too complex; simplify it within the DSL limits.
